title: The Harbor of Bellbird Bay Anew
author: Ansel Amberdale
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
